description: Spawns an agent that adds a new building type: leaf class + research row + registry + balancing subtree + slots (10B-10E pattern).

fields.description: Display name; drives the leaf class name, BUILDING_TYPE, balancing subtree key and branch slug.
fields.label: Building name

fields.description: Which parent/module the leaf hangs off (defence.py / economy.py / boost.py-style / structure.py). The parent computes derived stats.
fields.label: Parent family

fields.description: Advertises via the Attacker component + the 'combat' tag (never an IS_COMBAT flag) so the combat sweep stays type-agnostic.
fields.label: Combat building

fields.description: ResearchSpec.starts_unlocked. False = earned via a level-up unlock reward.
fields.label: Starts unlocked

fields.description: ResearchSpec.gate_kind. The spec stores WHERE in buildings.json the gate value lives, never the value. `none` = no gate_kind: leave it unset (ResearchSpec's default is Python None, not the string 'none').
fields.label: Unlock gate

fields.description: How many tier sprite prefixes (TIER_SPRITES) and slots.json tier groups to add.
fields.label: Tier count

title: Add New Building
